LESSON: PRE-CAREER SUPPORT SYSTEMS (PSYCHOSOCIAL, SOCIAL, MENTORSHIP/COACH ING, SPIRITUA

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Social Studies and Career Development
Topic 1.2: Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why does a learner need pre-career support?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth
2. appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRE-CAREER SUPPORT SYSTEMS (PSYCHOSOCIAL, SOCIAL, MENTORSHIP/COACH ING, SPIRITUA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: PRE-CAREER SUPPORT SYSTEMS (PSYCHOSOCIAL, SOCIAL, MENTORSHIP/COACH ING, SPIRITUA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua. (skill: appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why does a learner need pre-career support?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Pre-career Support systems (Psychosocial, social, mentorship/coach ing, spiritua means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the significance of pre-career mapping for individual growth.
5. Be able to: appreciate the value of the pre-career support systems.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
